assets.desc: the same muscular broad-shouldered man ('gigachad' build: wide shoulders and chest, thick neck and arms, narrow waist, strong legs, normal-sized boots), short dark hair, stubble, square jaw, wearing a worn quilted khaki telogreika jacket, dark grey work trousers and brown boots, walking. Use the attached image ONLY as a pose and camera reference: top row = facing the camera and to the right (front 3/4), bottom row = facing away from the camera and to the right (back 3/4); copy each frame's exact pose, leg and arm positions, body proportions and the high top-down camera angle, but paint a real person in our style instead of the grey mannequin. Every frame the same person, same size, feet on one baseline per row. Gloomy post-Soviet survival, muted desaturated natural colours (olive, khaki, grey-brown), hand-painted like Project Zomboid and Rust, soft overcast light from the top-left, strong readable volume.
